scope: R63 fixed Ghost64, all40 frozen0.5 eval cases, one repeat; local development evidence

definitions.cost_ratio: Per-case Total_Score(candidate)/Total_Score(own fresh paired original Naive), lower is better.
definitions.mean: Arithmetic mean of all 40 per-case ratios, equal case weights; not ratio of summed costs.
definitions.P50: Ordinary median, middle pair arithmetic mean for even n.
definitions.P90: Nearest rank ceil(0.90*n), using all n.
definitions.zero_denominator: 0/0 is 1, positive/0 is Infinity retained; Infinity encoded as a JSON string.
definitions.family: Original recorded family/family_definition from the complete CSV; coverage filename group is coarse, unlike the earlier R60-R62 scenario subgroups.
definitions.D: Per-case scheduler callback total in microseconds, including history reconciliation, action-intent validation, scanning, and action generation.
definitions.scope: One repeat on all actual nonempty eval sets in the fixed 0.5 snapshot; unknown official sample count/distribution is not predicted.

aggregate.aggregation: sum of per-case arithmetic mean over repeats

uncapped_case_point_diagnostic.scope: Existing local per-case rule only, not predicted official points. Per-case clipping hides regression magnitude; read actual cost and D tails.
